methods.evidence_summary: Autonomy-support and work-redesign research informs conditions; no direct test of this agreement.
methods.application_limit: Decision rights, useful support and actual work conditions must change; fewer questions alone is not improvement.
methods.open_question: Which delegation conditions improve delivery without suppressing necessary escalation in this setting?

methods.evidence_summary: A randomized professional-coaching bundle included GROW; broader coaching studies often exclude managers/peers.
methods.application_limit: Neither the acronym alone nor this short manager-led rendition was isolated; chosen goals and evaluative power matter.
methods.open_question: Does this conversation support the person's goal better than instruction or a resource decision?

methods.evidence_summary: Feedback meta-analysis includes benefits and negative effects; perceived listening supplies adjacent context.
methods.application_limit: The evidence does not validate SBI/SBII wording or predict benefit from delivering a message.
methods.open_question: Does the next attempt change the work outcome, or does feedback redirect attention into defensiveness?

methods.evidence_summary: Conflict synthesis, conceptual negotiation readings and a publisher book excerpt clarify tradeoffs.
methods.application_limit: Task conflict is not beneficial on average; these are not tests of this negotiation sequence.
methods.open_question: Which interests are genuinely tradable, and is agreement better than the realistic alternative?

methods.evidence_summary: Safety research explains risks around voice; originator guidance describes the sequence.
methods.application_limit: No direct comparative effectiveness evidence for 1-2-4-All was established; participation is not safety.
methods.open_question: Can material concerns reach a legitimate owner without pressure or retaliation?

methods.evidence_summary: Team literature informs plan coherence; handoff/charter studies are adjacent evidence.
methods.application_limit: A five-minute workplace huddle is not the clinical handoff bundle or a charter intervention.
methods.open_question: Does resetting this plan reduce stale-plan errors enough to justify the burden?

methods.evidence_summary: Debrief meta-analysis supports an intervention family; only its abstract was inspected here.
methods.application_limit: No promised local percentage improvement or detailed unread subgroup claim; hindsight can distort explanations.
methods.open_question: Does a specific adjustment carry into the next comparable episode?

methods.evidence_summary: PDSA review appraises application/reporting; research-methods texts explain inference.
methods.application_limit: It does not establish that more faithful PDSA causes better outcomes; local before/after change is confounded.
methods.open_question: Was the change delivered, did its prediction hold, and what rival explanation remains?

methods.evidence_summary: Work-redesign review includes mixed and negative outcomes; HSE supplies work-design guidance.
methods.application_limit: Neither a brief tradeoff discussion nor reduced workload at one point establishes system improvement.
methods.open_question: Was a commitment actually changed without displacing hidden burden elsewhere?

methods.evidence_summary: Observational influence-tactic study provides limited, abstract-inspected support for consultation.
methods.application_limit: Associations are not causal tactics or a universal ranking; outcome varies with authority relationship.
methods.open_question: Can genuine consultation alter the proposal, and is refusal preserved as a legitimate result?

methods.evidence_summary: Perspective-getting experiments were checked at abstract level; direct accounts can supply new information.
methods.application_limit: No workplace-script validation or presumption that any account is complete or true.
methods.open_question: What new account or observation actually changes the interpretation?

methods.evidence_summary: Training/transfer meta-analyses and learning chapters distinguish acquisition, use and maintained performance.
methods.application_limit: Program-level moderator associations do not validate this short sequence or a universal practice schedule.
methods.open_question: Can the person demonstrate the task later where it is used, with support and an actual opportunity?

methods.evidence_summary: Original prospective-hindsight scenario studies concern explanation generation.
methods.application_limit: They do not establish superior forecasts or success of a full team premortem.
methods.open_question: Which plausible failure mechanism has evidence, an observable warning and an owned response?

methods.evidence_summary: I-PASS before/after study supports a clinical implementation bundle; team chapters add context.
methods.application_limit: Check-back alone was not isolated, and pediatric error reductions cannot be promised in office work.
methods.open_question: Does accepted transfer preserve the next action, contingencies and critical dependencies at an acceptable cost?

methods.evidence_summary: Charter/strategy study and newer scholarly synthesis distinguish team norms from task strategy.
methods.application_limit: Original study is abstract-only here and has a figure-label correction; simulations and limited evidence constrain transfer.
methods.open_question: Does the agreement work with the actual strategy, expertise, resources and changing membership?

methods.evidence_summary: Goal-setting research explains mechanisms/moderators; implementation plans address a different gap.
methods.application_limit: Neither SMART phrasing nor uniformly harder targets is independently validated for this case.
methods.open_question: Is the missing ingredient a goal, a viable strategy, capability, feedback or opportunity?

methods.evidence_summary: Perspective-getting and team knowledge synthesis explain why actual affected accounts matter.
methods.application_limit: No comparative validation of a stakeholder grid or power/interest classification was established.
methods.open_question: Whose consequential knowledge or burden is missing, and can they safely correct the map?

methods.evidence_summary: CDC describes nominal-group procedure; safety findings identify contextual constraints.
methods.application_limit: No direct outcome study of this rendition was established; preference rankings are not factual truth or population consensus.
methods.open_question: Are eligible options ranked on a shared criterion, with consequential minority concerns retained?

methods.evidence_summary: PDSA reporting and measurement principles support a testable improvement theory.
methods.application_limit: No direct comparative efficacy evidence for the diagram was established; arrows are hypotheses.
methods.open_question: Which intermediate observation would challenge the key proposed link?

methods.evidence_summary: General research-methods explanation supports discriminating rival hypotheses.
methods.application_limit: No direct fishbone efficacy evidence was added; group agreement does not identify a cause.
methods.open_question: Which observation separates two plausible explanations and who will obtain it?

methods.evidence_summary: Measurement and positive-deviance readings inform observation and context.
methods.application_limit: No direct test of this mapping protocol was established; a map may omit exceptional work or shift waits.
methods.open_question: Does the map reflect actual cases and the entire affected process?

methods.evidence_summary: Review of change reactions supports separating actual conditions from deficit labels.
methods.application_limit: No causal validation of force-field scores or universal change stages was established.
methods.open_question: What observable barrier can change, by whose authority, and with what evidence of feasibility?

methods.evidence_summary: Large experimental synthesis supports contingent plans with heterogeneous, bias-sensitive effects.
methods.application_limit: Effect estimates depend on correction method; workplace transfer and component moderators are uncertain.
methods.open_question: Was the cue encountered/noticed, was the action feasible, and did executing it help?

methods.evidence_summary: Research design and PDSA principles support decision-relevant tests.
methods.application_limit: No direct efficacy test of an assumption-map workshop was established.
methods.open_question: Would either a confirming or contradicting observation change the decision?

methods.evidence_summary: Systematic review and critical monograph examine exemplar selection, explanation and transfer.
methods.application_limit: Excellence can reflect case mix or resources; discovery does not demonstrate a transferable cause.
methods.open_question: Is exceptional performance real and repeatable, and does the proposed practice help under receiving conditions?

methods.evidence_summary: Framing experiments demonstrate some preference reversals; textbook concepts support diagnosis.
methods.application_limit: They do not validate an entire discovery workshop or justify persuasive reframing.
methods.open_question: Does the decision change when equivalent consequences are presented differently, or have the facts changed?

methods.evidence_summary: Coaching synthesis explicitly excludes peers; a scholarly comparison helps distinguish helping roles.
methods.application_limit: No direct Troika trial was established; peer agreement does not prove advice or substitute for expertise.
methods.open_question: Which proposed option is testable, which needs evidence, and which requires specialist help?

methods.evidence_summary: Training transfer, developmental-experience studies and learning chapters support conditional development.
methods.application_limit: No IDP form or fixed stretch proportion is validated; observational challenge findings are not dose prescriptions.
methods.open_question: Was the promised experience available, and what learning transferred beyond successful delivery?

methods.evidence_summary: Framing and research-design knowledge complements NASA decision guidance.
methods.application_limit: No comparative validation of this scoring/review template; natural-unit criteria and explicit values remain judgments.
methods.open_question: Which plausible new fact or value tradeoff would reverse the choice?

methods.evidence_summary: Perceived-listening synthesis and perspective-getting research inform receiving an account.
methods.application_limit: Predominantly observational listening associations do not prove this script improves performance.
methods.open_question: Are material corrections represented accurately later, separately from feeling heard or agreeing?

methods.evidence_summary: Change-reaction review and transfer explanations distinguish support, belief and ability.
methods.application_limit: No universal stage model or messaging script is established; self-reported support is not feasible execution.
methods.open_question: Can affected roles perform ordinary work under the actual new conditions?

methods.evidence_summary: Scenario experiments examine perceived apology effectiveness, including null contrasts.
methods.application_limit: Ratings of wording do not establish restored trust, fulfillment or forgiveness.
methods.open_question: Were repair commitments kept and recurring harm reduced without pressuring the other person?
